echoParts: to those who believed in His name
verseText: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God.
meaning: When we believe that Jesus is the Son of God and trust in him to save us, we are adopted as children into God's forever family.

recall.question: What does God give those who receive Jesus and believe in His name?
choices: The right to be His children

meaning.question: What does it mean to become a child of God?
choices: We become part of God's forever family

application.prompt: When you believe in Jesus and trust Him to save you, God adopts you into His forever family! Even on days when you feel left out, lonely, or like you don't belong, remember that you are loved by your heavenly Father. You have a place in His family forever!
